CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Fixed a real stack-overflow crash opening a large file: render-highlighted-text's own line walk was a plain self-recursive function call (one C stack frame per line, not a real loop/recur) -- a real 57,524-line file crashed within ~6 seconds. Rewritten as a real loop/recur, verified stable for 19+ seconds on the same file. Honest gap remains: full-file re-tokenization every frame is real, separate, unbounded work -- true windowed rendering not attempted. CI green on all 4 jobs. PARENA commit c946ae9, Apple #16444. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
